description: Trip Planning Form, Budget Calculation, and Results UI Redesign: Redesign TripPlanner.tsx form to match clean professional style with clear field labels, From/To autocomplete (preserve existing geocodingService integration), date pickers, traveller count, travel style dropdown (Budget/Balanced/Comfortable), travel mode dropdown. Improve budget calculation display with clear breakdown cards. Create new result components: BudgetBreakdown.tsx, AccommodationList.tsx, FoodRecommendations.tsx, ActivitiesItinerary.tsx that display after form submission. Ensure all data comes from existing destinations.ts or is clearly labelled as estimates. No fabricated hotel/restaurant listings.
steps: Read src/components/TripPlanner.tsx (full file) to understand current form structure, validation logic, and results rendering
Read src/utils/plannerLogic.ts to understand generateTripPlan, validateTripInput, cost breakdown calculation, and itinerary generation logic

Redesign form section in TripPlanner.tsx: change from dark rounded cards to white cards with light borders; update all form fields to use new light theme styles (white bg, gray borders, blue focus rings); group fields logically with clear labels
Preserve autocomplete functionality for From/To fields using existing geocodingService.ts

Update travel style field: rename from 'mood/group/energy' complex selectors to simple 'Travel Style' dropdown with 3 options: Budget, Balanced, Comfortable (map these to energyLevel or create new field)
Update travel mode field to match requirements: Train, Bus, Flight, Car, Other (adjust MODE_COST_PER_DAY in plannerLogic.ts if needed for realistic estimates)
Improve form validation UI: show clear error messages in red below each field, not silent failures
Update 'Plan My Trip' button to new light theme style (blue background, white text, clear hover state)
In plannerLogic.ts, review cost breakdown calculation: ensure it supports INR for Indian destinations, has clear per-person calculations, and all costs are labelled as estimates

Create src/components/BudgetBreakdown.tsx: component that receives CostBreakdown interface from plannerLogic and displays: Transportation, Accommodation, Food, Local Transport, Activities, Total, Per Person; use card layout with clear typography; include disclaimer 'Estimates based on travel style, not guaranteed booking prices'
Update TripPlanner.tsx results section: after form submit and itinerary generation, render BudgetBreakdown component with itinerary.costBreakdown data

Review accommodation recommendations: currently TripPlanner may show accommodation from attraction data or generate placeholder; ensure any accommodation shown is clearly labelled 'Estimated budget accommodation' or uses real data from destinations.ts if available; add disclaimer if no verified listings exist

Create src/components/AccommodationList.tsx (or inline in TripPlanner results): show 3-4 budget accommodation options per destination IF data exists in destinations.ts; otherwise show message 'Accommodation recommendations: Budget hotels and hostels available in [destination]. Estimated ₹3000-5000 per night. Please verify availability and booking.' with disclaimer; no fabricated hotel names or fake booking links

For food recommendations, use existing localFood array from destinations.ts: create src/components/FoodRecommendations.tsx that maps over itinerary.destination.localFood and displays each food with photo from assets if available, otherwise use placeholder or text-only card; include description from destinations data; no invented restaurant names, just dish names and typical price estimates from plannerLogic food calculations

For activities and itinerary, use existing itinerary.days from plannerLogic: create src/components/ActivitiesItinerary.tsx that renders day-by-day schedule with itinerary.days.stops mapped to cards; each stop shows: name, description, duration, estimated cost, time slot; use attractions data from destinations.ts; if no attractions available, show clear message 'Curated attraction schedules available for featured destinations. For [custom destination], add your own stops using the form.' with transparency about data availability
Update all results components to use light theme: white cards, gray borders, blue accents, dark text, clean typography
Ensure TravelMap.tsx integration still works: map should render with stops from itinerary, light theme popup styles, and proper attribution
acceptance_criteria: TripPlanner.tsx form has clean white background, light borders, clear labels, and improved field grouping
From and To fields have working autocomplete using geocodingService (Photon API)
Travel Style dropdown has Budget/Balanced/Comfortable options
Travel Mode dropdown has Train/Bus/Flight/Car/Other options
Form validation shows clear red error messages below invalid fields
BudgetBreakdown component displays cost breakdown with clear INR formatting, per-person costs, and estimate disclaimer
Accommodation section clearly labels estimates and does not show fabricated hotel listings
Food recommendations use localFood data from destinations.ts with no invented restaurants
Activities itinerary uses attractions data from destinations.ts with transparency about data availability for custom destinations
All results sections use light theme styling consistent with FEAT-001
TravelMap still renders with light theme and shows itinerary stops correctly
Manual testing: fill form, submit, verify budget breakdown displays, food list shows destination-specific foods, activities show day-by-day schedule, map renders with markers
verification: Fill out trip form with: From 'Mumbai', To 'Goa', dates, 4 days, 2 travellers, Balanced style, Car mode
Click 'Plan My Trip' and verify form validates correctly (show errors if fields missing)
After submit, verify BudgetBreakdown section appears with: Transport ₹X, Accommodation ₹Y, Food ₹Z, Activities ₹A, Total ₹B, Per Person ₹C, disclaimer text
Verify Food Recommendations section shows Goan foods from destinations.ts (Goan Fish Curry, Poi Bread, Bebinca, Prawn Balchão)
Verify Activities section shows day-by-day itinerary with Goa attractions from destinations.ts (Palolem Beach, Fontainhas, Fort Aguada, etc.)
Verify TravelMap renders below with markers for each attraction and light-themed popups
Test with custom destination (use search to add non-featured place): verify transparency messages appear for accommodation/activities data
Verify no fabricated hotel names or fake booking links anywhere in output
findings: Successfully redesigned TripPlanner.tsx with clean light theme (white backgrounds, gray borders, blue accents). Implemented working From/To autocomplete using existing geocodingService.ts (Photon API) with dropdown suggestions showing real places worldwide. Added Travel Style dropdown (Budget/Balanced/Comfortable) and Travel Mode dropdown (Train/Bus/Flight/Car/Other). Improved form validation with clear red error messages below fields. Created BudgetBreakdown.tsx component displaying cost breakdown with INR formatting, per-person costs, and clear estimate disclaimers. Created AccommodationList.tsx showing transparent budget accommodation guidance without fabricated hotel listings. Created FoodRecommendations.tsx using localFood data from destinations.ts (e.g., Goan Fish Curry, Bebinca for Goa). Created ActivitiesItinerary.tsx rendering day-by-day schedule with attractions from destinations.ts. Updated TravelMap.tsx to light theme (white backgrounds, blue markers, light popups). All components use consistent light theme styling. Updated plannerLogic.ts to support new TravelMode options and TravelStyle field. Form calculates days from departure/return dates. Budget breakdown includes INR currency with disclaimers that estimates are not guaranteed booking prices. No fabricated hotel names or restaurant listings anywhere. Build and lint pass successfully.
